Title: The Body Unbound
Subtitle: A Woman's Guide to Understanding Endometriosis Calming Inflammation and Living Beyond the Pain
Author: Hannah Wells
Description: Endometriosis affects one in ten women yet it remains one of the most misunderstood conditions in women's health. The Body Unbound is the practical guide that cuts through the confusion, explaining what endometriosis actually is, how to get a diagnosis that has been delayed for years, what treatment options really work, and how to build a full life around this condition.

Title: The Restless Soul
Subtitle: A Woman's Guide to ADHD Spirituality and Finding Peace in a Busy Brain
Author: Clara Bennett
Description: If you have an ADHD brain and have ever tried to meditate pray or sit still in spiritual practice and felt like a failure this book is for you. The Restless Soul bridges the gap between the neurodivergent mind and the spiritual life, offering a radically different approach: instead of trying to fix your brain to fit spiritual advice it reimagines spiritual practice for the brain you actually have.
